mapper.sql: vehicle_seq, center_seq, region_seq, driver_seq, vehicle_name, model, vehicle_type_cd, vehicle_num, vehicle_reg_num, model_year, vehicle_reg_area, owner_name, length, width, ton_grade, max_loading_capacity, fuel_type_cd, fuel_efficiency, vehicle_use_type_cd, garage_name, usage_yn, created_at, creator_seq, modified_at, modifier_seq
mapper.update: UPDATE t_vehicle SET center_seq = #{centerSeq}, region_seq = #{regionSeq}, driver_seq = #{driverSeq}, vehicle_name = #{vehicleName}, model = #{model}, vehicle_type_cd = #{vehicleTypeCd}, vehicle_num = #{vehicleNum}, vehicle_reg_num = #{vehicleRegNum}, model_year = #{modelYear}, vehicle_reg_area = #{vehicleRegArea}, owner_name = #{ownerName}, length = #{length}, width = #{width}, ton_grade = #{tonGrade}, max_loading_capacity = #{maxLoadingCapacity}, fuel_type_cd = #{fuelTypeCd}, fuel_efficiency = #{fuelEfficiency}, vehicle_use_type_cd = #{vehicleUseTypeCd}, garage_name = #{garageName}, usage_yn = #{usageYn}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, modifier_seq = #{modifierSeq} WHERE vehicle_seq = #{vehicleSeq}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.vehicle_seq, a.center_seq, b.center_name, a.region_seq, c.region_name, a.driver_seq, d.driver_name, a.vehicle_name, a.model, a.vehicle_type_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'VehicleType' AND com_code_cd = a.vehicle_type_cd) AS vehicle_type_cd_name, a.vehicle_num, a.vehicle_reg_num, a.model_year, a.vehicle_reg_area, a.owner_name, a.length, a.width, a.ton_grade, a.max_loading_capacity, a.fuel_type_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'FuelType' AND com_code_cd = a.fuel_type_cd) AS fuel_type_cd_name, a.fuel_efficiency, a.vehicle_use_type_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'VehicleUseType' AND com_code_cd = a.vehicle_use_type_cd) AS vehicle_use_type_cd_name, a.garage_name, a.usage_yn, a.creator_seq, e.admin_name AS creator_name, a.created_at FROM t_vehicle a LEFT JOIN t_center b ON a.center_seq = b.center_seq LEFT JOIN t_region c ON a.region_seq = c.region_seq LEFT JOIN t_driver d ON a.driver_seq = d.driver_seq LEFT JOIN t_admin e ON a.creator_seq = e.admin_seq
AND a.vehicle_name LIKE '%' || #{vehicleName} || '%'
AND b.center_name LIKE '%' || #{centerName} || '%'
AND a.vehicle_type_cd = #{vehicleTypeCd}
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.vehicle_seq, a.vehicle_name, a.vehicle_num, a.region_seq, a.center_seq, a.length, a.width, a.max_loading_capacity, b.driver_name FROM t_vehicle a LEFT JOIN t_driver b ON a.driver_seq = b.driver_seq WHERE a.region_seq = #{regionSeq}

SELECT a.vehicle_seq, a.vehicle_name, a.vehicle_num, a.region_seq, a.center_seq, a.length, a.width, a.max_loading_capacity, b.driver_seq, b.driver_name FROM t_vehicle a LEFT JOIN t_driver b ON a.driver_seq = b.driver_seq WHERE a.center_seq = #{centerSeq}

SELECT a.vehicle_seq, a.vehicle_name, a.region_seq, c.region_name, b.driver_name FROM t_vehicle a LEFT JOIN t_driver b ON a.driver_seq = b.driver_seq INNER JOIN t_region c ON a.region_seq = c.region_seq INNER JOIN t_region_range d ON c.region_seq = d.region_seq WHERE a.center_seq = #{centerSeq} AND d.eup_myeon_dong = #{eupMyeonDong}
